title: Modified-Duty Shortening of Work Conditioning and Work Hardening Program Days
content:
# Modified-duty shortening

A worker who is back at work on modified duty attends a shorter program day in the Work Conditioning Program or the Work Hardening Program of the Workers' Compensation Referral.

**Rule.** The modified-duty shortening is one (1) hour where the worker's work status on file is modified duty and twenty-eight (28) or more calendar days have passed since the initial evaluation, two (2) hours where the work status on file is modified duty and fewer than twenty-eight days have passed, and none otherwise.

The work status is the one on file on the referral record; the initial evaluation is the date of service of the referral's evaluation charge.

## Combinations

| Work status on file | Calendar days since the initial evaluation | Shortening |
|---|---|---|
| modified duty | fewer than 28 | 2 hours |
| modified duty | 28 or more | 1 hour |
| off work | any | none |
| full duty | any | none |

## Edges

- Modified duty, day 27 since the initial evaluation: 2 hours.
- Modified duty, day 28: 1 hour.

## Case (hypothetical)

A worker in the Work Hardening Program has a work status of modified duty on file. The initial evaluation was 35 calendar days before the program day. The shortening is 1 hour. Had the evaluation been 20 days before, it would be 2 hours.
